records.text:
Chief Complaint: Poorly controlled blood sugars and a non-healing wound on the left foot.

History: 67-year-old female with type 2 diabetes mellitus for 15 years on metformin and glargine. Reports polyuria and fatigue. Exam: 1.5 cm shallow ulcer on plantar surface of left first metatarsal head, no purulence, monofilament sensation reduced bilaterally.

Assessment:
1. Type 2 diabetes mellitus with hyperglycemia
2. Diabetic foot ulcer, left foot
3. Diabetic peripheral neuropathy

Plan: Increase glargine to 28 units nightly, add empagliflozin, podiatry and wound care referral.

records.title: XR Left Foot 3 Views
records.content:
Exam: XR Left Foot 3 Views
Findings: Soft tissue swelling adjacent to the first metatarsal head. No cortical erosion or periosteal reaction.
Impression: No radiographic evidence of osteomyelitis.

records.text:
Chief Complaint: Worsening shortness of breath and leg swelling for one week.

History: 76-year-old male with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (EF 30%) admitted with acute decompensated heart failure. Diuresed with IV furosemide, net negative 4.2 L. Weight down 3.8 kg.

Assessment:
1. Acute on chronic systolic heart failure
2. Hyponatremia
3. Hypertension

Plan: Furosemide 40 mg twice daily, continue carvedilol and sacubitril-valsartan. Daily weights. Cardiology follow-up in 7 days.

records.title: XR Chest 2 Views
records.content:
Exam: XR Chest 2 Views
Findings: Cardiomegaly. Bilateral interstitial opacities and small bilateral pleural effusions.
Impression: Findings consistent with pulmonary edema and cardiomegaly.

records.text:
Chief Complaint: Fever, productive cough and right-sided pleuritic chest pain for 3 days.

History: 34-year-old female, temperature 39.1 C, HR 108, SpO2 93% on room air. Crackles over the right lower lung field. No recent travel or hospitalization.

Assessment:
1. Community-acquired pneumonia, right lower lobe
2. Sepsis ruled out

Plan: Amoxicillin-clavulanate plus azithromycin for 5 days, return precautions, PCP follow-up in 1 week.

records.title: XR Chest 2 Views
records.content:
Exam: XR Chest 2 Views
Findings: Dense consolidation in the right lower lobe with air bronchograms. No pleural effusion.
Impression: Right lower lobe pneumonia.

records.text:
Chief Complaint: Increased dyspnea and sputum production.

History: 63-year-old male former smoker (40 pack-years) with COPD admitted for acute exacerbation. Treated with nebulized bronchodilators, prednisone and doxycycline. CT obtained to exclude pulmonary embolism.

Assessment:
1. COPD with acute exacerbation
2. Incidental 8 mm pulmonary nodule, right upper lobe

Plan: Prednisone taper, tiotropium. Repeat CT chest in 3 months for nodule follow-up per Fleischner guidance.

records.title: CT Chest Angiogram
records.content:
Exam: CT Chest Angiogram
Findings: No pulmonary embolism. Centrilobular emphysema, upper lobe predominant. 8 mm solid nodule in the right upper lobe.
Impression: No PE. Emphysema. 8 mm indeterminate right upper lobe nodule; follow-up CT recommended.

records.text:
Chief Complaint: Palpable lump in the left breast noticed 4 weeks ago.

History: 53-year-old female, no family history of breast cancer. Exam: 2 cm firm, mobile mass at the left breast 2 o'clock position, no axillary lymphadenopathy.

Assessment:
1. Left breast mass, BI-RADS 4 on imaging

Plan: Ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy scheduled. Discussed possible outcomes.

records.title: Diagnostic Mammogram and Ultrasound, Left
records.content:
Exam: Diagnostic Mammogram and Ultrasound, Left
Findings: Irregular 1.9 cm hypoechoic mass with indistinct margins at 2 o'clock, 6 cm from the nipple.
Impression: BI-RADS 4C: high suspicion for malignancy. Tissue sampling recommended.

records.text:
Chief Complaint: Right wrist pain after a fall on an outstretched hand.

History: 39-year-old male fell from a ladder. Swelling and tenderness of the distal right radius, neurovascularly intact.

Assessment:
1. Closed fracture of the distal right radius

Plan: Closed reduction, sugar-tong splint, orthopedics follow-up in 5 days.

records.title: XR Right Wrist 3 Views
records.content:
Exam: XR Right Wrist 3 Views
Findings: Transverse fracture of the distal radial metaphysis with 15 degrees of dorsal angulation.
Impression: Distal radius fracture (Colles type).

records.text:
Chief Complaint: Rising creatinine noted by primary care.

History: 72-year-old female with long-standing hypertension and type 2 diabetes. On lisinopril and spironolactone. No NSAID use.

Assessment:
1. Chronic kidney disease stage 3b
2. Hyperkalemia
3. Hypertension

Plan: Stop spironolactone, low-potassium diet, repeat BMP in 1 week.

records.title: US Renal Bilateral
records.content:
Exam: US Renal Bilateral
Findings: Right kidney 9.1 cm, left kidney 9.4 cm with increased cortical echogenicity. No hydronephrosis.
Impression: Findings consistent with medical renal disease. No obstruction.

records.text:
Chief Complaint: Wheezing and chest tightness after exposure to wildfire smoke.

History: 24-year-old male with mild persistent asthma. Peak flow 55% of predicted, improved to 80% after three albuterol-ipratropium nebulizers.

Assessment:
1. Asthma exacerbation, moderate

Plan: Prednisone 40 mg for 5 days, start inhaled budesonide-formoterol, asthma action plan reviewed.

records.title: XR Chest 1 View
records.content:
Exam: XR Chest 1 View
Findings: Mild hyperinflation. No focal consolidation or pneumothorax.
Impression: No acute cardiopulmonary process.

records.text:
Exam: CT Head without Contrast
Findings: No intracranial hemorrhage, mass effect or acute infarct.
Impression: Negative non-contrast head CT.

records.title: MRI Brain without Contrast
records.content:
Exam: MRI Brain without Contrast
Findings: Restricted diffusion in the left frontal operculum and insula consistent with acute infarct.
Impression: Acute left MCA territory infarct. No hemorrhagic transformation.

records.text:
Exam: US Pelvis Transvaginal
Findings: Enlarged uterus with two intramural fibroids measuring 3.2 cm and 2.1 cm.
Impression: Uterine fibroids, likely cause of menorrhagia.

records.title: CT Abdomen and Pelvis with Contrast
records.content:
Exam: CT Abdomen and Pelvis with Contrast
Findings: Dilated 11 mm appendix with wall enhancement and periappendiceal fat stranding. No abscess.
Impression: Acute uncomplicated appendicitis.

records.text:
Exam: Transthoracic Echocardiogram
Findings: Left ventricular ejection fraction 55%. Moderate left atrial enlargement. No significant valve disease.
Impression: Preserved LV function with moderate left atrial enlargement.

records.title: XR Bilateral Hands
records.content:
Exam: XR Bilateral Hands
Findings: Periarticular osteopenia and early marginal erosions at the second MCP joints bilaterally.
Impression: Findings compatible with erosive inflammatory arthritis.

Chief Complaint: Follow-up call after discharge.

History: Patient reports weight stable, mild ankle swelling, no orthopnea. Adherent to furosemide.

Assessment:
1. Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction, compensated

Plan: Continue current regimen.
